record.label: The 121 settings for m parallel queries and k targets
record.statement: The authors independently vary the number of parallel queries $m$ and the number of targets $k$ over the eleven powers of two from $1$ to $1024$.
record.boundary: Comparator checks that each selector is nonempty and that each selected pair lies on the grid. The selector definitions also give the converse. Both return true for every pair of the eleven powers of two.
